description:
Turn your voice into polished text.

Ultra-fast AI powered dictation that understands what you want to say and how you want to say it. Instantly turn speech into perfect emails, crisp notes, clear messages, professional communication, and more.
Features
- Ctrl+Win can now be used for push to talk, toggle recording, and mode shortcuts, and is offered during onboarding
Improvements
- Clearer notices when a model can't run on hardware. On ARM, Whisper, Cohere Transcribe, and S1-mini explain they aren't available and point to Parakeet or a cloud model.
- S1-mini tone slider updated to match macOS
- Organization-managed custom models now show an organization icon and a short explanation instead of a delete button
Fixes
- BYOK custom models now blocked when your organization turns off cloud models. Local models, models your organization provides, and local Ollama still work
- Mode editor top bar buttons highlight correctly on hover
